title: Beneath The Waves, India Secretly Tested A Nuclear Capable Ballistic Missile That Can Cover Pakistan, Parts Of China - K-4 Revealed
description: On December 23, 2025, India silently carried out a submarine-launched ballistic missile test in the Bay of Bengal. The missile is believed to be the nuclear-capable K-4 with a range of around 3,500 km, launched from an Arihant-class submarine. The test further strengthens India’s sea-based nuclear deterrent.

title: Pakistan’s Airspace Got Smaller: Meet India's Next-Generation Air Defence Weapon That Is Deadlier Than Akash
description: The DRDO has successfully completed trials of the Akash-NG missile, which is capable of intercepting high-speed aerial threats at altitudes ranging from 30 metres to 20 kilometres. Equipped with indigenous seekers and dual-pulse motors, this advanced system will soon join the Indian Army and the Air Force.

title: Missing for 2 months, Shahkot youth caught in Pak’s Kasur sector
description: A Shahkot-based youth, missing for nearly two months, has reportedly crossed the India-Pakistan border and has been apprehended in the neighbouring nation’s Kasur sector. Pakistan released a photograph on Wednesday showing the missing youth, Sharandeep Singh (23), a resident of Bhoepur village in Shahkot, with Pakistan Rangers. However, it is still not clear under what circumstances Sharandeep crossed the border.
